name: FastPeopleSearch

search.notes: Pattern from auto-identity-remove. Search pages served a security challenge on 2026-10-27.

steps: Open the opt-out page, enter the name and email and complete the captcha yourself.
Open the emailed link within 24 hours.
Fill the form so it matches the record and submit.
optout.notes: The page says to allow 3 days. The site's notice also offers phone opt-out at (866) 679-8725 and says listings may come back as new public records arrive. Operated by Mississippi Tornado Alley, LLC per the 2026 California registry, along with FastPeopleSearch, USPhonebook, SearchPeopleFree, SmartBackgroundChecks, CyberBackgroundChecks and AdvancedBackgroundChecks. Each site has its own opt-out.

sources.attribution: California Privacy Protection Agency data broker registry, 2026 list fetched 2026-10-27

verification_note: Opt-out start page and the notice that links to it loaded on 2026-10-27. The page uses a Turnstile captcha.
